Returns execution records on that executor that have reached a terminal state (success/failed/timeout/killed/cancelled), ordered by terminal time ascending, so callers can consume it as a watermark stream. Executors use it to triage dead letters: a dead-letter callback for an execution already in a terminal state is meaningless (delete it outright); one whose execution has not finished and whose dead-letter cause is an exhausted retry budget is worth re-enqueuing; poison payloads (oversized/corrupt) are retained for manual investigation. dependencies.description: 上游任务依赖映射：{ 显示名: 上游任务id }——**value 才是依赖任务 id**（环检测、依赖满足、扇出匹配等所有消费方都读 value）。每个 value 必须是已存在的任务 id；自依赖与循环在写面即被拒绝。
dependencies.x-i18n-en: Upstream task dependency map: { display name: upstream task id } - **the value is the dependency task id** (all consumers, including cycle detection, dependency satisfaction, and fan-out matching, read the value). Every value must be an existing task id; self-dependencies and cycles are rejected on the write path.

timeout.description: 任务执行超时秒数（遗留字段；建议使用 timeoutSeconds）。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（executor-node 每次尝试都会以 400 拒绝更大的值）。
timeout.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds (legacy field; prefer timeoutSeconds). 0 = unlimited; capped by the executor's 1..86400 window (executor-node rejects larger values with 400 on every attempt).

timeoutSeconds.description: 任务执行超时秒数。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（会归一化到 `timeout`，executor-node 对超过 86400 的值以 400 拒绝）。
timeoutSeconds.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds. 0 = no limit; capped at the executor's 1..86400 window (normalized to `timeout`; executor-node rejects values above 86400 with 400).

timeoutAction.description: CORE-04：任务超时后的动作。kill（缺省）= 执行器按既有语义树杀进程；kill_retry = 同样树杀，但 admin 按任务的重试预算重新入队一次执行；notify_only = admin 只下发超时告警、不额外下发终止指令（执行器自身的硬超时仍然生效）。PATCH 时缺省 = 保留当前值；显式 null = 重置回 kill。
timeoutAction.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: action after a task times out. kill (default) = the executor kills the process tree using the existing semantics; kill_retry = the same tree kill, but admin re-enqueues one execution according to the task's retry budget; notify_only = admin only raises a timeout alert and sends no extra termination instruction (the executor's own hard timeout still applies). On PATCH, absent = keep the current value; explicit null = reset back to kill.

timeoutWarnRatio.description: CORE-04：超时预警阈值，取 timeout 的百分数（整数 0-90）。运行时长达到 timeout × ratio/100 时发送一次 WARNING 预警通知（每个执行至多一次）。缺省/null = 未启用。
timeoutWarnRatio.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: timeout warning threshold, a percentage of timeout (integer 0-90). When the run duration reaches timeout x ratio/100, one WARNING notice is sent (at most once per execution). Default/null = disabled.

estimatedDurationSec.description: CORE-05：预估执行时长（秒；0 或缺省 = 未知）。仅用于调度侧的 executor 负载评分（预估越长，对繁忙执行器的惩罚越大）；执行链路（心跳/超时/统计）从不消费该字段。PATCH 时显式 null = 重置为未知。
estimatedDurationSec.x-i18n-en: CORE-05: estimated execution duration (seconds; 0 or default = unknown). Used only by the scheduling side for executor load scoring (a longer estimate penalizes busy executors more); the execution path (heartbeat/timeout/statistics) never consumes this field. On PATCH, an explicit null = reset to unknown.

executeMode.description: 派发模式：single（在符合条件的执行器中选择负载最低的一台，缺省）或 broadcast（扇出到所有符合条件的在线执行器）。与 executorId 钉定互斥；当绑定应用带有互斥组时以 400 拒绝（broadcast 无法遵守组内并发上限）。
executeMode.x-i18n-en: Dispatch mode: single (pick the least loaded of the eligible executors; default) or broadcast (fan out to all eligible online executors). Mutually exclusive with pinning via executorId; rejected with 400 when the bound application has a mutex group (broadcast cannot honor the in-group concurrency cap).

params.description: 任务默认参数；序列化后体积不得超过 65536 字节（与 trigger/webhook 面同一上限）。
params.x-i18n-en: Default task parameters; the serialized size must not exceed 65536 bytes (the same limit as the trigger/webhook surface).

secrets.description: 任务级 secrets（凭据键值对，独立于 params 的普通运行参数；配置了 SEC_SECRETS_KEY 时以 AES-256-GCM 加密落库，未配置则降级明文并告警）。读路径一律以字面量 ****** 掩码。派发时走两条通道：合并进 params（AUTOFLOW_<KEY>，旧执行器通道）并作为独立载荷字段下发，使执行器按**原名**注入（第三方 SDK 要求规范名）。PATCH 时按**逐键合并**：键缺省或叶子值为 ****** 时保留已存值，叶子值为 null 时删除该键，其它值覆盖；整个字段显式 null 时清空全部 secret。
secrets.x-i18n-en: Task-level secrets (credential key-value pairs, independent of the ordinary run parameters in params; persisted encrypted with AES-256-GCM when SEC_SECRETS_KEY is configured, otherwise degraded to plaintext with a warning). Read paths always mask them with the literal ******. Dispatch uses two channels: merged into params (AUTOFLOW_<KEY>, the legacy executor channel) and sent as a separate payload field so the executor injects them under their **original names** (third-party SDKs require canonical names). On PATCH they are merged **key by key**: a missing key or a leaf value of ****** keeps the stored value, a leaf value of null deletes that key, any other value overwrites; an explicit null for the whole field clears all secrets.

deploymentPolicy.description: FEAT-22：任务级部署派发策略覆盖。'strict' 把候选收窄为显式部署了绑定应用的设备集合（running/stopped/upgrading）；当其中没有任何设备可承接该执行时，执行会以 WAITING 排队，而不是静默派发到别处。'prefer' 保留 ARCH-35 的软偏好（优先尝试已部署且运行中的设备，否则回落到全集群）。缺省/null = 跟随全局 executor.deploymentPolicy（EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY）。优先级：executorId 钉定 > executorAppName > 部署约束 > 全集群；总开关 executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false 会彻底关闭部署感知。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null = 跟随全局。
deploymentPolicy.x-i18n-en: FEAT-22: task-level deployment dispatch policy override. 'strict' narrows the candidates to the set of devices that explicitly deployed the bound application (running/stopped/upgrading); when none of them can take the execution, it queues as WAITING instead of being silently dispatched elsewhere. 'prefer' keeps the ARCH-35 soft preference (try deployed and running devices first, otherwise falls back to the whole cluster). Default/null = follow the global executor.deploymentPolicy (EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY). Precedence: executorId pinning > executorAppName > deployment constraint > whole cluster; the master switch executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false turns deployment awareness off entirely. PATCH: omitted = keep; explicit null = follow the global setting.

executorAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签亲和（OR 语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即为候选；随后在命中集合内按 loadScore 择优）。broadcast 模式下扇出收窄为命中亲和标签的执行器子集。与 executorTags（硬性 AND 子集能力要求）正交。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor tag affinity (OR semantics - an executor holding **any** of these tags is a candidate; the best is then chosen within the matching set by loadScore). In broadcast mode the fan-out narrows to the subset of executors matching the affinity tags. Orthogonal to executorTags (a hard AND subset capability requirement). PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorAntiAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签反亲和（排除语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即被排除）。单发与 broadcast 均生效；与亲和标签组合时，先取亲和命中集再在其上剔除。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAntiAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor label anti-affinity (exclusion semantics - an executor holding **any** of these labels is excluded). Applies to both single dispatch and broadcast; when combined with affinity labels, the affinity hit set is taken first and then filtered. PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorId.description: 把任务钉定到指定执行器：派发**只**发往该执行器（绕过分组/标签过滤）；它离线时快速失败。与 executeMode=broadcast 互斥。
executorId.x-i18n-en: Pin the task to a specific executor: dispatch goes **only** to that executor (bypassing group/label filtering); it fails fast when that executor is offline. Mutually exclusive with executeMode=broadcast.

codeSource.description: 代码来源渠道。gitRepo / glueSource / codeSource=application_zip（需配 applicationId）三者中只能设置一个。PATCH 时缺省 = 保留当前值；显式 null = 清除声明。requirements/PyPI 属于依赖型渠道，可与任一代码来源并存。
codeSource.x-i18n-en: Code source channel. Only one of gitRepo / glueSource / codeSource=application_zip (requires applicationId) may be set. On PATCH, omitting it = keep the current value; an explicit null = clear the declaration. requirements/PyPI is a dependency-type channel and may coexist with any code source.

runbook.x-i18n-en: FEAT-11: markdown runbook - shown on the task detail page and attached to failure notifications/alerts.

'prefer' keeps the ARCH-35 soft preference (try deployed and running devices first, otherwise falls back to the whole cluster). Default/null = follow the global executor.deploymentPolicy (EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY). Precedence: executorId pinning > executorAppName > deployment constraint > whole cluster; the master switch executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false turns deployment awareness off entirely. createdBy.x-i18n-en: Username of the creator (JWT username). null = legacy row/official seed; rows with a null owner can be deleted by ADMIN only.

category.description: 粗分类标签（备份/巡检/同步/清理/通知…），前端渲染为 Tag
category.x-i18n-en: Coarse category label (backup/inspection/sync/cleanup/notification...), rendered as a Tag by the frontend

key.description: 稳定标识；缺省由 name 规整生成。官方模板保留 [a-z][a-z0-9_-]* 命名风格。
key.x-i18n-en: Stable identifier; generated by default from a normalized name. Official templates keep the [a-z][a-z0-9_-]* naming style.

config.description: 合法 CreateTaskDto 子集（省略 name）；作为实例化任务的默认值
config.x-i18n-en: Valid subset of CreateTaskDto (omitting name); used as defaults for the instantiated task

overlay.description: 覆盖字段（与 CreateTaskDto 同形状；显式字段胜出模板默认）。至少需 name。
overlay.x-i18n-en: Overlay fields (same shape as CreateTaskDto; explicit fields win over template defaults). At minimum, name is required.

name.description: 任务名称（取自 overlay 请求体；在全部任务中唯一）
name.x-i18n-en: Task name (taken from the overlay request body; unique across all tasks)

status.description: 所创建任务的生命周期状态
status.x-i18n-en: Lifecycle status of the created task

triggerType.description: 由模板 config / overlay 展开得到的触发类型
triggerType.x-i18n-en: Trigger type expanded from the template config / overlay

runtime.description: 执行器将使用的运行时

userId.description: 属主用户 ID（整数）。null = 系统级订阅（由 ADMIN 管理，对所有管理员可见，并为排查问题向所有用户开放读权限）。
userId.x-i18n-en: Owner user ID (integer). null = system-level subscription (managed by ADMIN, visible to all administrators, and readable by all users for troubleshooting).

eventTypes.description: 订阅的事件名（稳定目录，只增不改）：execution.completed / execution.failed / executor.offline / deployment.completed
eventTypes.x-i18n-en: Subscribed event name (stable catalog, append-only): execution.completed / execution.failed / executor.offline / deployment.completed

url.description: 回调 URL（公网 http(s)；写入时做 SSRF 深度校验，并在每次外发投递前重新检查）
url.x-i18n-en: Callback URL (public http(s); deep SSRF validation on write, re-checked before every outbound delivery)

secret.description: HMAC 签名 secret —— 在所有读面恒为掩码占位符 '******'（明文仅在创建时以 generatedSecret 返回一次）
secret.x-i18n-en: HMAC signing secret -- always the masked placeholder '******' on every read view (the plaintext is returned only once at creation as generatedSecret)

consecutiveFailures.description: 连续投递失败次数（任一次成功即重置为 0）
consecutiveFailures.x-i18n-en: Consecutive delivery failure count (reset to 0 on any success)

lastFailureAt.description: 最近一次投递失败的时间戳；null = 从未失败
lastFailureAt.x-i18n-en: Timestamp of the most recent delivery failure; null = never failed

lastFailureError.description: 最近一次失败摘要（截断至 512 字符；绝不含 secret/payload）
lastFailureError.x-i18n-en: Most recent failure summary (truncated to 512 characters; never contains the secret/payload)

url.description: 回调 URL（公网 http(s) 端点；内网地址会被拒绝）
url.x-i18n-en: Callback URL (public http(s) endpoint; internal addresses are rejected)

eventTypes.x-i18n-en: Name of the event to subscribe to

secret.description: HMAC 签名密钥。省略则由服务端生成 32 字节十六进制密钥（仅在创建响应中返回一次，之后不再展示）。
secret.x-i18n-en: HMAC signing secret. When omitted, the server generates a 32-byte hex secret

subscription.description: 新建的订阅（secret 已掩码）

generatedSecret.description: 服务端生成的 32 字节十六进制 secret —— 仅在本响应中返回一次。调用方自带 secret 时不出现。
generatedSecret.x-i18n-en: Server-generated 32-byte hexadecimal secret - returned only once, in this response. Absent when the caller supplies its own secret.

enabled.description: 是否启用投递（true=启用，false=停用）

eventTypes.x-i18n-en: Replacement set of events for the subscription

eventType.description: 投递失败的事件名（例如 execution.failed）
eventType.x-i18n-en: Name of the event whose delivery failed (e.g. execution.failed)

payload.description: 发送时刻的完整外发信封（event/occurredAt/data）
payload.x-i18n-en: Full outbound envelope at send time (event/occurredAt/data)

error.description: 最近一次失败摘要（截断至 1024 字符）
error.x-i18n-en: Summary of the most recent failure (truncated to 1024 characters)

attempts.description: 实际投递尝试次数（首次尝试 + outbox 扫描器重试，受 MAX_OUTBOX_ATTEMPTS 限制）
attempts.x-i18n-en: Actual number of delivery attempts (first attempt + outbox scanner retries, capped by MAX_OUTBOX_ATTEMPTS)

createdAt.x-i18n-en: Recorded time of this dead letter (ISO-8601)

ok.description: 本次单次重放投递是否成功
ok.x-i18n-en: Whether this single replay delivery succeeded

error.description: ok=false 时的失败摘要（该行会保留以便再次尝试）
error.x-i18n-en: Failure summary when ok=false (the row is retained for another attempt)

keyPrefix.description: 'acf_' + 前缀若干字符——创建之后不再返回完整 key
keyPrefix.x-i18n-en: 'acf_' + a few prefix characters - the full key is never returned again after creation

scopes.description: 额外的细粒度范围（词表，例如 'task:trigger'）

revokedAt.description: 有值 = 已吊销（软删除）

plaintext.description: 明文 key（'acf_<64 hex>'）仅展示一次——请立即保存
plaintext.x-i18n-en: Plaintext key ('acf_<64 hex>') is shown only once - save it immediately

myRole.description: 调用主体在该项目中的角色；非成员为 null。ADMIN 也会在这里拿到其真实的成员行（如实返回，不做合成）。
myRole.x-i18n-en: Role of the calling principal in this project; null for non-members. ADMIN also gets its real membership row here (returned truthfully, not synthesized).

list.description: 分页行（items 的 legacy 别名）

projectName.description: 项目名称（确认框标题回显）
projectName.x-i18n-en: Project name (echoed as the confirmation dialog title)

taskCount.description: 该项目下未软删除的任务数（status != deleted）。这些任务删除后会退回「未分配」视图
taskCount.x-i18n-en: Number of non-soft-deleted tasks in this project (status != deleted). After deletion these tasks fall back to the "unassigned" view

activeTaskCount.description: 其中处于 active 状态的任务数——删除后仍会被 cron 触发，是真正会持续产生副作用的那部分
activeTaskCount.x-i18n-en: How many of those tasks are active -- they keep being triggered by cron after the deletion, which is the part that keeps producing side effects

memberCount.description: 项目成员关系行数（删除时由 FK ON DELETE CASCADE 一并清除）
memberCount.x-i18n-en: Number of project member rows (cleared together by FK ON DELETE CASCADE on delete)

deletable.description: 是否可删；默认项目恒为 false（remove 会返回 404 PROJECT_DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE）
deletable.x-i18n-en: Whether the project is deletable; always false for the Default project (remove returns 404 PROJECT_DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE)

userId.description: 调用方用户 ID；请求未携带用户时为 null
userId.x-i18n-en: Caller user ID; null when the request carries no user

isAdmin.description: 调用方为 ADMIN 时为 true（admin-web 据此渲染全部项目）
isAdmin.x-i18n-en: true when the caller is ADMIN (admin-web renders all projects based on this)

memberships.description: 调用方在所有项目中的成员关系行
memberships.x-i18n-en: The caller's membership rows across all projects
